subject.title: Feature Request: Stream Repetition Safeguard (Halt & Confirm)

question: What product behavior should OpenClaw use when assistant streamed text appears to be repeating: abort-only, pause-and-confirm, or a configurable/opt-in guard?
rationale: The missing implementation is clear, but the permanent behavior affects false positives, user-visible delivery, session state, and whether an existing run can safely resume after a semantic stream abort.

options.title: Abort and reset the turn
options.body: Stop the provider stream, discard buffered repeated output, mark the turn as failed or cancelled, and require a new user turn to continue.

options.title: Pause and ask for confirmation
options.body: Stop streaming, alert the user, and allow an explicit resume/cancel path after maintainers define how to resume safely without replaying poisoned context.

options.title: Defer to timeout/sanitizer work
options.body: Do not add a semantic stream guard yet; rely on generation-timeout and output-sanitizer issues to reduce symptoms while accepting continued token burn during active repetition.

recommendation.title: Abort and reset the turn
recommendation.body: Stop the provider stream, discard buffered repeated output, mark the turn as failed or cancelled, and require a new user turn to continue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from current blame, prior discussion, and adjacent tool-loop/config history.
